**BLUF:** In Tazewell, VA, a statue of Baseball Hall of Famer Billy Wagner was dedicated along Main Street today. In the immediate region, a Princeton, WV man faces warrants for possessing over 300 suspected child sexual abuse images, while a Princeton woman was charged after a vehicle pursuit in nearby Summers County. No active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the core area today.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/19/tazewell-dedicates-billy-wagner-statue/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core (Tazewell County VA / Bluefield VA / Mercer County WV):**  
Nothing new reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, local police departments, or Mercer County authorities. Earlier items include a Tazewell County Drug and Violent Crimes Task Force search warrant executed Oct. 8 at a Bluefield, VA tobacco/vape shop, seizing over 606 grams of illicit cannabis (charges pending). A Bluefield, WV man, Christopher J. Loucks, 48, was charged Oct. 14 with felony strangulation and child abuse after a domestic incident on Willow Street.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/14/felony-charges-lodged-after-domestic-altercation/)

**Region (nearest first):**  
- Princeton, WV (Mercer County): William Ray Heath Jr. faces arrest warrants for possession of more than 300 suspected child sexual abuse images (including AI-generated) discovered on his cellphone; investigation began Oct. 3 after a report to Princeton Police; he is in Southern Regional Jail.[[3]](https://www.lootpress.com/princeton-man-found-with-over-300-child-sexual-abuse-images-on-cellphone/)
- Princeton, WV woman Katelyn Neal, 28, charged after a hit-and-run investigation led to a pursuit in Summers County on Oct. 16; charges include fleeing with reckless indifference, driving on suspended license, leaving the scene, wrong-way on one-way street, and unregistered vehicle. No injuries reported.[[4]](https://woay.com/princeton-woman-facing-several-charges-following-car-chase-in-summers-county/)
- Two people facing drug charges after a traffic stop resulting in seizure of nearly a pound of suspected methamphetamine (WOAY report, location details in Summers/Kanawha area).[[5]](https://woay.com/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-investigating-two-gunshot-deaths/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in the core or immediate region. A prior Tazewell County house fire (Peery Addition Road area) on Oct. 10 left one woman dead (investigation ongoing by Virginia State Police). A Bluefield home fire on Oct. 15 caused damage but no injuries.[[6]](https://www.yahoo.com/news/fire-damages-bluefield-home-115400115.html)

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. Weather remains dry with a small warm-up expected. No reported VDOT/WVDOH closures or major power/water issues in the core. National School Bus Safety Week is underway, with reminders from Virginia State Police and Tazewell County Public Schools (TCPS) to stop for buses.[[7]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/missing-people/elderly-disabled-man-with-dementia-reported-missing-in-tazewell-county/)

A TCPS school bus (Bus 71) was involved in an accident Oct. 12; all students were evaluated by EMS, with one taken to the hospital for further evaluation.[[8]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-public-schools-releases-statement-about-school-bus-accident/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County Board of Supervisors adopted a new policy (effective around Oct. 15) requiring non-profits receiving county funding to certify they do not employ or have registered sex offenders on their boards.[[9]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/new-policy-regarding-sex-offenders-and-non-profits-takes-effect-in-tazewell-county/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Average gas prices declined 9.7 cents in the past week (Bluefield Daily Telegraph report). Tazewell County Public Schools celebrated National School Lunch Week with cafeteria themes. Graham’s Cheer Team placed first in a competition.[[10]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/15/tazewell-county-schools-celebrate-national-school-lunch-week/)

**Region:** Live2Lead leadership conference returns to Bluefield, WV on Wednesday. Summers County ARH clinic entrance and parking lot closing for construction.[[11]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/19/live2lead-conference-returning-bluefield/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Live2Lead conference in Bluefield, WV (Wednesday).  
- Ongoing National School Bus Safety Week emphasis on stopping for buses.  
- No scheduled major court dates, meetings, or weather hazards noted in available reports. Dry conditions expected to continue.
